notes.title: Chuusotsu! 1st Graduation Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28680774/df3466aa1063c940fac8b556082030073e7b79dc.jpg
We're happy to announce that Chuusotsu! 1st Graduation: Time After Time will release on Steam in 2 weeks' time, April 24!

The Steam release will feature dual language (English and Japanese text, with Japanese audio), and all-new CGs funded through its successful Kickstarter campaign!

A brand new opening video can also be seen on the Steam page.

Get ready to do some crazy philosophy!
